_comment: Per-user access rules. Copy to runtime/identity_policy.json and edit.
Keys under 'users' are the OpenWebUI user id — the 'sub' claim of the
forwarded token, not the display name or the e-mail address.
Deny by default: a user who is not listed here reaches nothing, and
neither does anyone while this file is missing or unreadable.
'account' and 'credentials_file' are optional and opaque to the spawner:
it reads the file and hands the content to the tool that asks for it.
One account per file, chmod 600, and never a secret in this JSON.
The value read from the file is its last non-empty line, so an old value
may stay above the new one during a rotation.
